places.name: Kamalabari Satra
places.description: Watch classical Ankia Bhaona performance in the monastery where it has been preserved for 400 years.
places.bestTime: October to March; Raas festival in November

places.name: Auniati Satra
places.description: See 400-year-old Ahom royal treasures preserved inside a living monastery.

places.name: Raas Mahotsav Festival
places.description: Experience India's most unique all-night classical theatre tradition preserved on a river island.
places.bestTime: Kartik Purnima, November (exact dates vary annually)

places.name: Brahmaputra Sunset Ferryboat View
places.description: The Brahmaputra sunset ferry crossing is as spectacular as anything you find on the island.
places.mapsSearch: Nimati Ghat ferry Jorhat Majuli Assam
places.bestTime: October to March, late afternoon crossing

places.name: Natun Samaguri Satra Mask Workshop
places.description: Buy a 16th-century theatrical art form directly from the monks who invented it.
places.mapsSearch: Samaguri Satra mask workshop Majuli Assam

places.name: Garamur Satra
places.description: Watch Sattriya — India's most recent classical dance — in its original monastery courtyard.

places.name: Mising Tribal Village — Ali Aye Ligang Festival
places.description: Enter a living stilt-house village whose culture bridges Vaishnavism and river animism.
places.bestTime: February (Ali Aye Ligang); October to March generally

places.name: Majuli Pottery Village — Salmara
places.description: Watch a rare underground-kiln black pottery tradition that predates Assam's Ahom kingdom.

places.name: River Island Cycling
places.description: Cycle between 400-year-old monasteries on traffic-free bunds above the Brahmaputra floodplain.

places.name: Migratory Bird Wetlands of Majuli
places.description: Spot rare migratory ducks in ox-bow lakes accidentally protected by monastery sacred ponds.
